LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_AbyssalHarpoonProjector: A brutal projector that pins the advance with abyssal harpoons, turning momentum into restraint.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_AbyssalThreatPrioritize: A compact turret support brain that weighs hostile mass, command signatures and abyssal hierarchy before the chassis chooses a target.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_AntiSwarmPatternScanner: A fan-array scanner that reads clustered motion and teaches the chassis to punish bodies that move as a swarm.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_AshChoirRepeaterCore.de: A cycling ash-canticle feed for suppressing bodies rather than breaking armor. Its rhythm is cruel, fast and deliberately wasteful.
A load-governor block that dims hungry abyssal circuits, trading firing tempo for a colder and more obedient grid draw.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_ChoirArcEmitter.descrip: A secondary canticle emitter that answers clusters with a slow Choir pulse, leaving the main weapon free to keep firing.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_ChoirArcEmitter.label: Choir Arc Emitter
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_CinderMortarCore.descri: An arcing cinder heart for punishing clusters, entrenched shooters and enemies that mistake distance for safety.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_CinderMortarCore.label: Cinder Mortar Core
A limiter assembly that lets close-range locks open earlier, allowing heavy modules to engage nearer threats without fully collapsing safety geometry.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_CoolingLattice.descript: A bound heat lattice that pulls waste heat out of the weapon path, forcing a tighter firing cadence at a heavier power cost.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_CoolingLattice.label: Cooling Lattice
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_CrowncoilGaussMinigun.d: A crowncoil engine that turns disciplined gauss fire into a storm of repeated verdicts against elite bodies and heavy swarms.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_EmergencyHeatDump.descr: A violent purge assembly that vents stored heat between firing cycles, helping an overheated turret recover before the next verdict.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_EmergencyHeatDump.label: Emergency Heat Dump
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_LongChoirLens.descripti: An elongated choir-aligned sighting lens that stretches turret geometry into a patient long-range verdict.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_LongChoirLens.label: Long Choir Lens
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_NullArcDischarger.descr: A null-arc coil that turns stored charge into a punishing pulse against shields, machines and clustered elite support.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_NullArcDischarger.label: Null-Arc Discharger
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_OverpressureCycleGovern: A brutal pressure governor that forces the weapon path into a harsher rhythm, sacrificing reach and grid stability for cadence.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_PlasmaLanceCore.descrip: A sealed ultra-plasma channel tuned for patient armor breaking. It favors long reach and impact over rate of fire.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_PlasmaLanceCore.label: Plasma Lance Core
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_ResidueCapacitor.descri: A residue-fed charge vessel that steadies the weapon between bursts, improving reach and cadence without becoming a weapon itself.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_ResidueCapacitor.label: Residue Capacitor
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_RiftFlakBloom.descripti: A compact rift seed that blossoms into cutting fragments around impact, made to punish bodies packed too closely together.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_RiftFlakBloom.label: Rift Flak Bloom
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_RiftNeedlerCore.descrip: A rift-needle lattice bound into a turret heart. It snaps out quick bursts that tear through light targets and slow dense swarms.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_RiftNeedlerCore.label: Rift Needler Core
A prism emitter that compresses sanctified violence into a narrow line, punishing enemies who stack behind one another.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_SanctifiedStabilizerPla: A pale-gold stabilizer slab that clamps the chassis under judgment geometry, dulling incoming punishment at the cost of firing aggression.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_SepulcherRailCore.descr: Twin sepulcher rails drink power in silence before releasing one long, decisive penetrator against armored elites.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_SepulcherRailCore.label: Sepulcher Rail Core
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_ShieldBurnCapacitor.des: A crown-fed capacitor that locks turret attention onto shields, machines and construct bodies before their protection can dominate the field.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_TargetingSigil.descript: A targeting sigil that stretches sighting geometry into a colder, steadier line of judgment.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_TargetingSigil.label: Targeting Sigil
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_VesperLanceArray.descri: A saint-clean lance array built for deliberate punishment: more precise than plasma, less ponderous than a sepulcher rail.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_VesperLanceArray.label: Vesper Lance Array
LanguageData.ABY_TurretPlasmaLanceBolt.label: turret plasma bolt
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_BreachAegisRelay.label: Breach Aegis Relay
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_BreachAegisRelay.descri: A compact relay that wraps an abyssal turret chassis in a shallow sacrificial aegis field. It is not a wall; it is a delay bought with power and residue charge.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_CrownAegisMatrix.label: Crown Aegis Matrix
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_CrownAegisMatrix.descri: A crown-tier aegis lattice that forces incoming punishment to spend itself against a pale-gold verdict field before the turret body can be reached.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModule_ExecutionLogicCore.desc: A verdict processor that lets a modular turret recognize damaged hostile bodies as targets already close to collapse.
